products.name: Bloomberg GPT
products.note: Finance-specific LLM; market data integration; proprietary data handling; trading decision risk

reading.body:
Bloomberg's only listed AI product is a finance-specific language model, Bloomberg GPT, built on its own market data and proprietary data handling.

The company is a single-product entry in this dataset, founded in 1981 and headquartered at 731 Lexington Avenue. Its AI work is described as tied to market data integration and trading decision risk, which places it in finance and legal AI rather than in general-purpose model development. The pattern is an incumbent data owner applying a model to data it already controls.

That matters for AI scaling because the constraint here is not compute or power but data rights and regulatory exposure in trading decisions. A finance-specific model can be trained and served at a scale far below frontier general models, so it does not drive the same demand for buildings and grid capacity that large training runs do.

The data does not give model size, training compute, chip counts, data center locations, or power draw. It also does not say whether Bloomberg GPT is in production or research, or how it relates to Bloomberg's terminal business. Nothing here supports claims about Bloomberg's electricity use or its role in the grid constraint.
